claims: Real estate involves land and permanent improvements.
Real estate is categorized into residential, commercial, industrial, and land.
Residential real estate includes homes, condos, co-ops.
Commercial real estate includes offices, shopping centers.
Industrial real estate includes manufacturing, warehouses.
Land real estate includes vacant land, farms.
Real estate agents are compensated through commissions.
Real estate agent commissions are calculated as a percentage of the sale price.
Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) are companies that own income-producing real estate.
Buying shares of REITs is a liquid investment method.
Real Estate Investment Groups (REIGs) are companies that buy or build sets of apartment blocks.
Real Estate Investment Groups allow investors to purchase units through them.
Selling real estate involves listing the property on the MLS
